# exo — Agent Guide

## Project Overview

exo is a distributed AI inference system that connects multiple devices into a cluster. It enables running large language models across multiple machines using MLX as the inference backend and zenoh for peer-to-peer networking.

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the project
uv sync

# Run the main application
uv run exo

# Run tests
uv run pytest

# Run a specific test file
uv run pytest tests/test_specific.py

# Run linting
uv run ruff check .

# Format code
uv run ruff format .
```

## Architecture

### Core Components

- **`exo/`** — Main package
  - **`main.py`** — Entry point, CLI argument parsing, and app bootstrap
  - **`runner/`** — Inference runner that orchestrates model loading and generation across the cluster
  - **`worker/`** — Per-device worker that executes shards of the model
  - **`networking/`** — zenoh-based peer-to-peer transport, topic routing, and message serialization
